items.reason: Detail status menus use the same container-specific entries as row-list menus.
Detail y opens the container’s Copy menu without copying immediately.
Detail m opens the container’s Mute menu.
Both surfaces dispatch I through the shared runFlatVerb helper.
View gives the drain picker rendering priority while retaining the detail state.
Direct y and p handlers are removed from document peeks.
Neither detail list handles p as a direct action.
Existing r handlers retain item and artifact menu behavior on all three surfaces.
The shared status refusal appears through the detail frame’s flash fallback.
The shared copy refusal appears through the detail frame’s flash fallback.
The shared mute refusal appears through the detail frame’s flash fallback.
Container menus occupy Frame.Block and reduce the list’s available height.
Detail menus reuse row-list menu navigation and verb dispatch.
Menu Escape clears the menu without clearing the detail.
Detail openers target one container and bypass Selection menu construction.
Slash starts detail search; Enter applies it and restores normal detail routing.
Shared search grammar matches case-insensitive substrings with AND across terms.
Item search fields include only id, title, and type.
Artifact search applies the shared grammar to filename and type.
Escape restores filtering by the previously applied term.
Reopening search empties its buffer; applying it clears filtering.
Typing routes printable keys into TextField, including j, k, v, and r.
Detail synchronization reapplies its active query after polling.
The applied term renders in the detail frame’s subheader.
Empty search results name the query and explain how to clear it.
Artifact availability derives from the full artifact collection, preserving v switching.
Detail search state is independent and disappears when the detail closes.
Detail hints advertise r, s, y, m, and / without direct copy keys.
Peek hints remove direct copy-name and copy-path bindings.
Typing hints list only apply, cancel, and help.
Detail help includes menus, applicable I, search, and conditional clearing; peek help drops direct copies.
Contextual help handles detail container menus and detail search typing separately.

scores.rationale: Clear shared implementation with broad regression coverage; picker rendering and exact layout sizing lack direct tests. Assessment was static.
